lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Plate A to strip B, ~88 deg, across the ~9 mm neck between the relief notches. In sections at 25/50/75% the apex sits on the outer-skin apex (nearest scan point 0.02-0.08 mm; the inner skin is 1.4 mm further along the bisector). A sweep along the line finds fold apex points from t=-0.5 to ~9.0 mm against a line length of 8.4 mm, so about 93% coverage. Beyond the neck the slot separates A's edge, so there is no fold there and the shortened extent override is correct.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Strip B to end tab, ~89 deg. Sections at 25/50/75% put the apex on the outer skin (0.05-0.08 mm); the inner skin is 1.3-1.5 mm away and the tab's hole collar shows up as clutter at 50/75%. The sweep finds the fold from t=0 to ~11.0 mm against a line length of 10.64 mm, so the full strip width is covered.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Tab to hook lip, ~83 deg, bent the opposite way to B2 (Z profile, two separate bends). Sections at 25/50/75% put the apex on the outer skin (0.05-0.10 mm). The lip is about 4 mm wide; the fold is present from t=0 to ~4.0 mm against a line length of 3.7 mm, so about 92% coverage.
